skill.name: flow-nexus-platform
skill.description: Comprehensive Flow Nexus platform management for authentication, sandboxes, deployments, payments, storage, and challenges.
skill.summary: Manage Flow Nexus accounts, sandboxes, deployments, payments, storage, and coding challenges.
skill.author: ruvnet

security_audit.summary: Most static external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences and JavaScript template strings. Real risks remain because the skill guides remote sandbox execution, secret-bearing platform calls, billing changes, storage operations, and delegated tool use. No prompt injection attempt was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Secret-bearing examples use API keys and database URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Replace realistic credential formats with clearly fake placeholders, mark secret fields as sensitive, and require confirmation before sending secrets to Flow Nexus.

remediation.issue: Sandbox workflows can run packages, startup scripts, cloned repositories, and arbitrary code.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval before running code, installing packages, cloning repositories, or executing startup scripts. Prefer trusted sources and scoped sandboxes.

remediation.issue: Payment, auto-refill, tier, and credit actions can change account state.
remediation.suggestion: Add confirmation gates for payment links, auto-refill configuration, tier upgrades, and credit-changing operations.

remediation.issue: Delegated assistant tool use may perform broad platform actions.
remediation.suggestion: Keep external assistant tool access disabled by default and require explicit user approval for swarms, deployments, and code execution.

remediation.issue: Storage examples include public, private, shared, and temporary buckets.
remediation.suggestion: Default to private or temporary buckets for sensitive data and require review before creating public URLs.

semantic_findings.title: Remote Sandbox Code and Command Execution
semantic_findings.description: The skill documents package installation, startup scripts, repository cloning, and sandbox code execution. These actions can run untrusted code in a remote environment if used without review.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Multiple examples explicitly invoke sandbox_execute, run_commands, startup_script, package installation, and git clone. The actions are sandboxed, so the finding is high rather than critical.

semantic_findings.title: Secrets Sent to External Platform Tools
semantic_findings.description: The skill asks users to provide API keys, database URLs, and an Anthropic key to Flow Nexus calls. Those secrets may be exposed to the external service or logs if controls are weak.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The examples name API_KEY, DATABASE_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, api_key, database_url, and anthropic_key in tool parameters. The values are placeholders, but the intended workflow handles secret material.

semantic_findings.title: Billing and Credit State Changes
semantic_findings.description: The skill documents tier upgrades, payment link creation, auto-refill changes, and programmatic credit awards. These operations can affect money or account balances.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The referenced examples explicitly call upgrade, payment, auto-refill, and credit earning tools. The security concern is business-impacting side effects, not hidden malware.

semantic_findings.title: Delegated Tool Use by External Assistant
semantic_findings.description: The skill shows Seraphina chat with tool access enabled and describes creating swarms and deploying code. Delegating tool use can amplify prompt injection or authorization mistakes.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The example sets enable_tools to true and the prose states that the assistant can deploy code and orchestrate agents. No prompt injection text was found, but delegated tool execution is a real risk.

content.value_statement: Flow Nexus work spans accounts, sandboxes, deployments, storage, credits, and challenges. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a guided interface for managing those platform workflows.
actual_capabilities: Register, log in, inspect authentication status, and manage Flow Nexus user profiles.
Create, configure, execute, stop, and delete remote Flow Nexus sandboxes.
Browse, publish, update, and deploy Flow Nexus apps and templates.
Check balances, create payment links, configure auto-refill, and review transactions.
Upload, list, share, and delete storage files across Flow Nexus buckets.
Browse challenges, submit solutions, view leaderboards, and track achievements.
limitations: Requires Flow Nexus MCP tools and a valid Flow Nexus account.
Can affect credits, billing, storage, and deployments when authorized.
Does not independently verify the safety of code, templates, or repositories.
Secrets entered into platform calls are handled by the Flow Nexus service.

use_cases.title: Prepare a development sandbox
use_cases.description: Create a sandbox, install packages, set environment variables, and inspect startup logs before coding.

use_cases.title: Publish and operate platform templates
use_cases.description: Search templates, deploy an app, review analytics, and update marketplace metadata.

use_cases.title: Manage learning and credit workflows
use_cases.description: Find challenges, submit solutions, review achievements, and monitor credit balances.

prompt_templates.title: Check my account setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my Flow Nexus authentication status, profile, credit balance, and recent transactions. Ask before making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a sandbox safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Flow Nexus sandbox for a Node.js API project. List packages, environment variables, startup commands, and risks before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Deploy a template with review
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Flow Nexus backend templates, recommend one, explain deployment variables, and wait for approval before deploying.

prompt_templates.title: Audit platform operations
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Flow Nexus sandboxes, storage, active subscriptions, billing settings, and audit logs. Identify cleanup and risk-reduction actions.

output_examples.input: Check my Flow Nexus account and credit status before I start work.
output: Current credit balance and recent usage are summarized.
Any missing setup steps are listed.

output_examples.input: Prepare a Python machine learning sandbox for model training.
output: A sandbox plan lists the template, packages, runtime limits, and environment variables.
Credential and package risks are called out before creation.
The assistant waits for approval before running the setup.

output_examples.input: Help deploy an API template and monitor it.
output: Suitable templates are compared with deployment requirements.
Required variables and secret fields are identified.
Post-deployment analytics and logs are summarized.

best_practices: Confirm every action that changes billing, credits, deployments, storage, or user profile data.
Use temporary or scoped credentials when passing secrets to Flow Nexus tools.
Delete unused sandboxes, storage objects, and subscriptions after each workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not paste production secrets into examples or exploratory prompts.
Do not run untrusted repositories, packages, or startup scripts without review.
Do not enable autonomous tool use for external assistants without explicit limits.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages Flow Nexus accounts, sandboxes, apps, templates, credits, storage, real-time streams, and coding challenges.

faq.question: Does it require a Flow Nexus account?
faq.answer: Yes. Most workflows require Flow Nexus authentication and configured MCP tools.

faq.question: Can it run code?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide Flow Nexus sandbox execution, package installation, startup scripts, and deployed app workflows.

faq.question: Can it affect billing?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents payment links, auto-refill settings, credit balances, and transaction history.

faq.question: How should secrets be handled?
faq.answer: Use scoped credentials, avoid production values, and confirm before sending secrets to Flow Nexus tools.

faq.question: Is this only for Claude?
faq.answer: No. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
